description: This Java source file defines the class RetrieveConnectionStatusAggregatorActor, an Akka actor responsible for aggregating resource status messages from clients, sources, and targets in a connectivity monitoring context, and generating a combined connection status response.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStatusAggregatorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that aggregates resource status messages for a specific connection and responds with a combined connection status.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props object for actor instantiation with specific parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling logic for ResourceStatus messages, timeouts, and any other messages.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles receive timeout by sending a (partial) response and stopping the actor.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the receive timeout duration at actor startup.

methods.name: handleResourceStatus
methods.description: Processes received ResourceStatus messages, updates the aggregation, and determines if response is ready.

methods.name: getRemainingResponses
methods.description: Calculates how many resource responses are still expected.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Builds and sends the aggregated connection status response back to the sender.
